title: Offline behavior, retries, and telemetry

spans.text: Goal: apply “Offline behavior, retries, and telemetry” to a real program or device. The key principle is: Backoff reduces repeated retry load. In a project, follow this guidance: Jitter reduces synchronized reconnect storms from many devices.
